articles.summary: Fourth consecutive year on the list recognizes DHI's employee-first culture DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX), the parent company of Dice and ClearanceJobs, has been named to America's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® for 2026. This is DHI's fourth consecutive year on the list. The ranking is researched by Best Practice Institute (BPI) and published in The Wall Street Journal. The list recognizes companies where employees feel respected, valued and connected to their work. Rankings are based on BPI's Love of Workplace Index®, built on its validated SPARK model, drawing on survey data from more than 2.8 million employees across 1,800 companies. "Four years in a row says something about who we are," said Art Zeile, CEO of DHI Group. "Our people are the reason this company works. We help technologists and cleared professionals build their careers every day, so we hold ourselves to the same standard. When our team is growing, learning and building with AI, that shows up in the products we deliver
articles.title: DHI Group, Inc. Named to America's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® for 2026

articles.summary: Company Narrows Full-Year Revenue Guidance to $124–$126 Million and Raises Adjusted EBITDA Margin Guidance to 26% Today, DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX) (“DHI” or the “Company”) announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Compared to the Third Quarter 2025(1) Total revenue was $32.2 million, consistent with the year ago quarter. ClearanceJobs revenue was $16.5 million, up 18%. Dice revenue was $15.7 million, down 13%. Total bookings were $27.9 million, up 10%. ClearanceJobs bookings were $15.8 million, up 32%. Dice bookings were $12.1 million, down 9%. Net income was $2.4 million, or $0.06 per diluted share, a net income margin of 7%, compared to net loss of $4.3 million, or $0.10 per diluted share, a net loss margin of negative 13%. articles.title: DHI Group Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; ClearanceJobs Revenue Increases 18% and Bookings Grow 32%
